ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure, with one benzene ring on the left and one benzene ring on the right; the left benzene ring is connected to N through a carbon, and N is labeled with H; the central carbon is connected to N, is also connected to the right benzene ring, and is connected upward to the O in OH2+; there are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: count by fragments and exclude bonds involving hydrogen. The left benzene ring has 6 internal C-C bonds, and the left benzene ring to N has 1 bond; the right benzene ring has 6 internal C-C bonds, and the right benzene ring to the central carbon has 1 bond; the central carbon to N has 1 bond, and the central carbon to O has 1 bond. N-H and O-H bonds are not counted. The total is 6 + 1 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 16.

method.method_draft: Break the drawing into fragments. Count 6 C-C bonds in the left phenyl ring and 1 left phenyl-C to N bond. Count 6 C-C bonds in the right phenyl ring and 1 right phenyl-C to central carbon bond. Count the central C-N bond and the central C-O bond to OH2+. Exclude N-H and O-H bonds. Sum: 6 + 1 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 16.
